messages:
Maya (Comms): All-hands in 10. Quick heads-up: our remote guest (Jamie) might be on cell. Please double-check backup audio and slides.
Eli (Infra): Encoder looks fine. I patched a dropped segment last night; no outstanding alerts.
Kira (AV): Doing a mic sweep now. The presenter mic in room 2 has a flaky XLR connection — I have a wireless handheld ready.
Maya (Comms): If Jamie is on cell and audio is poor, option A: dial-in via bridge and record locally; option B: pull them into the livestream audio channel. Thoughts?
Sam (Product): For roadmap Qs, Lena will do a 90s intro then open for 8 minutes. Keep two bullets for Dedicated capacity and private deploy timelines.
Lena (CEO): Agreed. I'll emphasize SLA and the contract pipeline. Sam, have the slide with the new timelines ready as slide 3.
Kira (AV): Quick test: handheld gain set, but wireless group is on channel 4 which sometimes overlaps. I'll switch to channel 11.
Eli (Infra): If stream drops, quick command: ```ssh stream && sudo systemctl restart encoder```  (restores in ~10s). Also I have a laptop bridge ready on 10.0.1.5.
stream-bot: Reminder: recording scheduled to start in 8 minutes.
Maya (Comms): Kira, can you also mute the room monitor for the first 30s to avoid bleed? Last time we had echo right at the intro.
Kira (AV): Will do. Setting monitor mute for first 30s and enabling noise gate on the handheld.
Maya (Comms): @Lena do you want a cue for the Q&A handoff or should Sam jump in?
Lena (CEO): I'll hand to Sam after the 90s intro. Sam, be standing by with two short answers: caching improvements and pricing pilot.
Sam (Product): Copy. Short answers prepped.
Kira (AV): Soundcheck pass: room 2 handheld clean, host mic clean, slight hiss on wireless but within acceptable range when noise gate is on.
Eli (Infra): One more note: if we see high reconnects, switch encoder to fallback stream key: STREAM_FALLBACK_1975. Command to switch: ```curl -X POST "http://encoder/api/switch_key" -d 'key=STREAM_FALLBACK_1975'```
Maya (Comms): OK action list: (1) Kira swap if XLR hiccups, (2) Eli keep fallback commands handy, (3) Lena & Sam rehearse 90s intro/hand-off. React with :thumbsup: when ready.
Kira (AV): :thumbsup: swapping to channel 11
Eli (Infra): :thumbsup: fallback ready
Sam (Product): :thumbsup: ready to take Q&A
stream-bot: Recording started at 1975012500
Maya (Comms): Thanks everyone 609 see you in the room.
